name: Phoenix
industries: Semiconductor fab construction leads a manufacturing boom, alongside banking operations and healthcare systems.
intro:
Phoenix is building America's semiconductor future: TSMC's fabs rising in the north valley anchor a manufacturing investment wave that includes Intel's expansion and a supplier ecosystem measured in tens of billions. Those capital programs hire certified project managers in volume — construction, equipment installation, ramp management — while the metro's banking back offices and healthcare systems sustain steady PMO demand. You can join a live online cohort in Phoenix year-round, on either a weekend Sat–Sun or a midweek Wed–Thu schedule, both timed for comfortable Phoenix daytime rather than awkward hours; exact converted timings for each upcoming date appear in the table below. What holds steady: live weekend instruction, exam application guidance, full-length mocks, and direct trainer access until you're certified.

Phoenix is building the most-watched industrial corridor in America: semiconductor fabs and their supplier networks are pouring billions into the Valley, each plant a lattice of governed capital projects, while the finance and healthcare back-offices that moved here for cost keep steady program demand underneath. Certified project professionals are the connective tissue of that build-out. The course runs live online over two consecutive days shown in Phoenix local time on this page — note Arizona skips daylight saving, and the batch table handles that for you. The sourced Phoenix entries below give dated local salary figures for certified roles. The employer list shows the semiconductor-finance-healthcare mix, and fab suppliers can certify project engineering teams via private cohorts.

faq.a: Live classes run 09:00 AM – 06:00 PM CT, which is 07:00 AM – 04:00 PM MST in Phoenix. You can pick a weekend (Sat–Sun) or a weekday (Wed–Thu) cohort; each completes the course over two consecutive days.

faq.a: All batches are 100% live online, taught by an instructor over video with interactive exercises — there is no venue to travel to in Phoenix. You need a laptop, a stable connection and a free weekend.
